title: 完结感言
content_zh:
完本了。
其实还有一些东西可以写，但我觉得可以番外补上，整个故事主线到这，是可以完本了。
结局与最初的设定是有点偏差的，但大差不差，毕竟，我很早就给出提示了，鼎，就是帝因，帝因就是鼎。
我这本最初提及前世，提及暴食之鼎是从前世带来的，本身就是要写金手指的来历的。
偏差就在于，我本来想写到十劫结束，杨狱与诸劫英豪争雄，以最巅峰的状态去迎战帝因。
但写着写着就觉得不太对，帝因这样的人，会允许自己那样落幕吗？
所以，结局写的很慢，也很痛苦，现在，可以缓一缓了。
从第一次阳开始，狗子的状态就很不对劲，健忘到了一个令人发指的地步，昨天的章节今天就记不起来，这对于我这种来说，是很恐怖的。
很久才恢复一些，期间吃了不知道多少药，有没有效果不知道，但肠胃是出了点毛病……
写这章的时候，左侧太阳穴还突突乱跳……
感谢书友，感谢大家的支持。
完本后，缓一缓，养一养身体，看看书，充充电，顺便将我报名了五六年的驾照考下来……
当然，还有大道纪的结局，我要补上一个。
至于下一本写什么，有点思路，但没想好，但一定要是个爽快不拖沓的故事。
当然，那可能是蛮久之后的事情了。
最后，当然是喜闻乐见的献祭。
献祭以下，让诸位读者老爷平安喜乐，幸福安康。

content_en:
Completed.
In fact, there are still some things that can be written, but I think it can be added in extra chapters. The whole main story line is here, and the book can be completed.
The ending is a little different from the original setting, but it is not bad. After all, I gave the hint very early that Ding is Di Yin, and Di Yin is Ding.
My book initially mentions the past life, and mentions that the Cauldron of Gluttony was brought from the past life, which is to write about the origin of Goldfinger.
The deviation is that I originally wanted to write it until the end of the Ten Tribulations, when Yang Yu competes with the heroes of the Tribulations and fights against Di Yin in his peak state.
But as I write, I feel something is not right. Would a person like Di Yin allow himself to end like that?
Therefore, the ending was written very slowly and painfully. Now, I can take my time.
From the first time, Gouzi's state has been very wrong, and his forgetfulness has reached an outrageous level. I can't remember yesterday's chapter today, which is very scary for me.
It took me a long time to recover. I took a lot of medicine during this period and I don’t know if it had any effect, but there was something wrong with my stomach...
As I write this chapter, my left temple is still throbbing...
Thank you book friends, thank you all for your support.
After finishing this book, I will take a breather, recuperate my body, read a book, recharge my batteries, and pass the driver’s license test that I signed up for five or six years ago...
Of course, there is also the ending of the Great Chronicles, which I want to add.
As for what to write for the next book, I have some ideas, but I haven’t thought about it yet, but it must be a refreshing and non-procrastinating story.
Of course, that may be a long time later.
Finally, of course, there is the welcome sacrifice.
I offer the following sacrifice, may all readers be safe, happy, and healthy.
